title: Taekwondo Academy Website
description: Modern marketing site for a Taekwondo dojang with photo galleries and an achievements showcase.
fullDescription:
A responsive marketing website built for a Taekwondo academy, featuring an About page, an Achievements section for competition history, and a Gallery with auto-playing image carousels for "Academy Moments" and "Competition Glimpses," complete with hover-activated navigation arrows and indicator dots.

Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS on a Vite pipeline, using shadcn/ui for consistent, accessible UI components. A lightweight Express backend handles contact form email delivery.

title: DevJrnl
description: A personal developer journal app for logging daily development work.
fullDescription:
A developer journaling application designed to help track daily development work, notes, and progress over time in one place.

Structured as a client/server monorepo, with the client and server running concurrently during development and deployed together as a single app.

title: Automated Swimming Slot Booking
description: Automation script that books a daily swimming slot the instant it opens.
fullDescription:
An automation script that logs into a college booking portal and reserves the daily 5pm swimming slot the moment it becomes available, removing the need to manually race to book a time-sensitive, limited slot every day.

Built with Python and Playwright for reliable browser automation, containerized with Docker for consistent scheduled execution, with Resend wired in to send booking confirmation emails automatically.

title: AI Vendor Report Analyzer
description: AI-powered dashboard that scores vendor completion reports against a project's Scope of Work.
fullDescription:
An AI-powered admin portal that lets an admin upload a project's Scope of Work document alongside completion reports from multiple vendors, then submits them together to Google's Gemini API for automated, side-by-side evaluation.

For each vendor, the system extracts positives, negatives, and a completion score with supporting reasoning, ranks vendors accordingly, and lets the admin export the full comparison as a formatted PDF report.

title: Core Java Interactive Workshop
description: Custom-built interactive slide engine for teaching Core Java concepts.
fullDescription:
A custom-built interactive presentation engine for teaching Core Java, going well beyond static slides — with checkable progress tracking, syntax-highlighted code blocks, and hands-on practice on nearly every slide, including conceptual Q&A, coding drills, output predictions, and bug-debugging challenges with toggleable solution reveals.

Built entirely in vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with no frameworks, including a custom flowchart renderer built purely in CSS (skewed parallelograms, rotated diamonds) and a dedicated Projector Mode that scales up typography for classroom visibility, with progress and theme preferences persisted locally between sessions.

title: Complete Python Bootcamp
description: 165+ slide interactive Python bootcamp covering fundamentals through data science.
fullDescription:
A 165+ slide interactive presentation covering a complete Python bootcamp — from language fundamentals through advanced topics like object-oriented programming, NumPy, and Pandas — organized into 18 modules across a 30-day curriculum, with distinctly styled concept, example, tip, mistake, interview, and practice slide types.

Built on the Reveal.js presentation framework with a fully custom design system, paired with Python scripts using Matplotlib that generate the bar, line, pie, and subplot chart visuals used throughout the data-visualization modules.
